# storage_v47_db

A notebook written by this repo's own binary pinned at **lbug 0.21.2** (storage version **47**), i.e.
the pre-#930 `main` (`5b439421`) before the bump to lbug 0.23.0 (storage version 53). Used by
`crates/core/tests/storage_v47_migration.rs` (issue #930) to prove that a database created by the
previous release line opens under lbug 0.23.0, migrates, and serves correct reads, FTS (non-ASCII)
and vector searches.

This fixture can **only** be regenerated by a binary linked against lbug 0.21.2 (a 0.23.0 build
writes storage 53). Do not rebuild it from a tree whose pins have moved.

## Contents of `t.db.tar.gz`

- `t.db` — the database after a **clean shutdown** (SIGTERM, preceded by
  `knowledge_build_indices` and `knowledge_prepare_checkpoint`), so no `t.db.wal` sidecar. It
  carries the three FTS indexes (built by lbug 0.21.2's FTS extension) and the HNSW vector indexes
  over `Entity.name_embedding` / `RelatesToNode_.fact_embedding`. The ADR-0649
  `fts_built_by_lbug` marker in `SchemaState` reads `0.21.2`, so opening under 0.23.0 is a
  version change that must trigger the FTS rebuild.
- `wal/liminis/*.jsonl` — the matching WAL (embeddings stripped by design), used to exercise
  `knowledge_rebuild_from_wal`.

Embedding dimension is **768**.

| table | row | non-ASCII term |
|---|---|---|
| `Entity` | `Zürich` (summary "A city in Switzerland"), `東京` (summary "Capital of Japan"), `Alice` (summary "Alice lives in Zürich"), `Bob` | `Zürich`, `東京` |
| `RelatesToNode_` | `LIVES_IN`, fact `Alice → Zürich` | `→`, `Zürich` |
| `RelatesToNode_` | `KNOWS`, fact `Alice knows Bob` | (ASCII) |
| `Episodic` | `ep-nonascii`: `Alice — moved to Zürich, then visited 東京` | `—`, `Zürich`, `東京` |
| `Episodic` | `ep-ascii`: `Bob met Alice at the office` | (ASCII) |

## How it was built

```sh
cargo build -p lcg-service                      # at the unchanged 0.21.2 pins
python3 fake_embedder.py &                      # deterministic /v1/embeddings on :8765, dim 768
mkdir ws && cd ws
LCG_EMBEDDING_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1/embeddings ../target/debug/liminis-context-graph &
python3 ../build.py .lcg/service.sock           # writes the rows above, builds indices, prepare_checkpoint
kill -TERM %2                                   # clean shutdown
cp .lcg/db/liminis.db t.db && cp -R .lcg/wal wal && tar -czf t.db.tar.gz t.db wal
```

`build.py` and `fake_embedder.py` are kept here for reproducibility.
